SPEAKING ACTIVITY

Your Turn to Speak Now!

Now it’s time to speak! 🎤

Think of a small health problem of your own, or a case of pain you have experienced in the past, and share it with your classmates. You can talk about a real or imaginary small health problem. You do not have to share a personal experience if you do not want to. 🗣️

Don't worry about making mistakes! Just relax, speak clearly and do your best! 💪

Take a deep breath, press the ‘Record’ button, and express yourself freely! Just be careful, because once you submit your recording, you cannot change it.

Below are some useful expressions that you can include in your recording:

How to start

  • ○"Hi everyone! Let me tell you how I feel today..."
  • ○"Oh no! I am having a really bad day because..."
  • ○"Hello! I need some help today because..."

How to describe your problem

  • ○"I have back pain / a high fever / a sore throat / terrible toothache, etc."
  • ○"My tummy / neck / knee hurts a lot."
  • ○"I feel very tired and I can't move / study / walk properly."

How to finish

  • ○"I think I need to rest in bed."
  • ○"I hope I feel better tomorrow!"
